name: mflow-marketplace
description: Plugins for anyone building a system with AI (an SA, a PM or the system owner): a screen-first, spec-driven workflow, a requirement set agreed before the build, tests and reviews for any project, a Thai-capable knowledge base, technical studies such as a costed cloud modernization proposal, and how-to clips of the system recorded from a scenario.

plugins.name: mflow
plugins.description: Screen-first, spec-driven workflow: AGENTS.md + OpenSpec + Backlog.md + tests, with session memory hooks and hotspot charting for big business logic.

plugins.name: mreq
plugins.description: Requirements before the build: discussion docs for the stack, the code structure and each topic, a static UI kit and prototype screens, kept in mreq/ for any builder or tool to take.

plugins.name: mtest
plugins.description: Tests, reviews and E2E for a new or existing project without a spec tool: flow docs whose every step, branch and case has a test, a runner that records each run against its commit, and E2E with a cap on browsers.

plugins.name: tamra
plugins.description: Tamra knowledge base: connects the Tamra MCP server (URL and token asked at install); search, save, read and revise knowledge, create spaces for new projects or topics, and with an owner token manage members, tags, archive and withdraw.

plugins.name: mtech
plugins.description: Technical studies: /mtech:cloud-architecture reads a legacy system and delivers a cloud modernization proposal with official AWS / Azure / GCP prices, a formula-driven cost workbook, SVG / HTML diagrams and an install, test and handover plan.

plugins.name: mclip
plugins.description: How-to clips of a web system from a scenario file: real clicks, highlights, zoom, Thai captions and voice-over, rerun whenever the UI changes; optional finishing in the WeftCut editor.
